My friend came carrying flowers.
I lifted the heavy bag with one hand.
I went outside holding an umbrella.
Shall we lift this box together?

examples.ko: 저는 매일 한국어 문장을 하나씩 외워요.
examples.en: I memorize one Korean sentence every day.

examples.en: Do you memorize your friends’ phone numbers? — No, they’re in my phone.
My younger brother memorized the multiplication table.

dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

After class I reviewed the vocabulary.
It's review time now. Open your book.
What’s the review homework? — Writing the words.
I reviewed together with a friend.

explain: 복습은 배운 뒤에 다시 보는 거예요. 복(復)은 ‘다시’, 습(習)은 ‘배우다’라는 뜻이에요. ‘복습해요’도 ‘복습을 해요’도 괜찮아요.

dict_examples.ko: 나는 오늘 배운 수학 공식을 복습을 통해 완전히 익혔다.
dict_examples.en: I fully mastered the math formula I learned today through review.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: 복습 is looking at something again after you learned it: 복 means “again” and 습 means “learn”. Both 복습해요 and 복습을 해요 are fine.

examples.en: I have preview homework for tomorrow's class.
Preview time is usually thirty minutes.
I do the preparation before class.
I prepare the words on the subway.
The students prepare and then come to class.

explain: 예습은 수업 전에 미리 보는 거예요. 예습, 예약, 예매의 ‘예’는 모두 ‘미리’라는 뜻이에요.

dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: 예습 means looking at the lesson ahead of time. The 예 in 예습, 예약 (reservation) and 예매 (advance ticket) all carries the idea of “beforehand”.
